## About the Project

We introduce a new method: Non-parametric Data Simulation from Summary Statistics. The method is implemented as a compiled R package stats2data available at the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN), and as a ShinyApp. For detalis see the Github page: <https://sebastian-lortz.github.io/stats2data/>

### Publications

The method is introduced in the research project titled 'Simulating Raw Data from Reported Summary Statistics: A Non-parametric Approach', authored by Sebastian A. J. Lortz, Marieke E. Timmerman, Don van Ravenzwaaij.

### Contributors
